description: A muted madder-burgundy wool apron dress with understated dark woven edging over an opaque warm ivory linen shift, simple small bronze shoulder brooches and a narrow natural-wool woven belt. Follow the stated moderate normal neckline and sleeve-coverage layer, keeping the tailoring practical and historically grounded. Long skirt with simple brown leather shoes visible below, clean fine cloth of modest prosperous quality. No aristocratic regalia, heraldry, head covering, armor or weapons.
